rejected_rule.statement: In a mortgage decree under section 201 of the Civil Procedure Code, it is the duty of the Court to give directions as to the due publication of the sale and to see that the sale is carried out under conditions of sale previously approved by the Court.
rejected_rule.supporting_quote: "I set aside the order appealed against, and order that the sale be set aside. The defendant-appellant will have the costs of this appeal, but there will be no costs of the proceedings in the Court below. Before disposing of this appeal. I should like to point out that in the case of a mortgage decree under section 201 it is the duty of the Court to give directions as to the due publication of the sale, and to see that the sale is carried out under conditions of sale to be previously approved of by the Court."
